summary: RSA read-only REST surface is correct, purely additive, and CORS is RSA-scoped. Verified against git diff (base 31650651d8) and FEAT-001/002/003 evidence.

Stats KPI math verified live (usedSlots 8, overallUtilization 0.25).
checks.cors_scoped_to_rsa: PASS — RsaCorsFilter is registered ONLY in RsaWebApplication.getClasses(); it decorates the /onos/rsa context only and touches no other ONOS REST surface. Cross-origin GET carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Unauthenticated OPTIONS preflight is 401'd by ONOS's controller-wide Karaf auth before reaching the RSA app; correctly resolved at the nginx proxy per the user's explicit decision (option A), not by loosening global auth.
